items.title: Dave Rivello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rochester, New York, January 11, 2012
items.q: Duke Ellington said, “There’s only two kinds of music, good music and bad music.” So I try to live by that also.

ctx.x: Well said. Is there pop music these days that you like?

There’s some things that catch my interest, not a huge amount I guess lately. But for a while I listened to the alternative rock station, only in the car, I never listen to it on a radio at home. And I would hear bits and pieces of things that I guess have somehow worked their way into my music, because younger guys or guys that play with my band say oh yeah, I could tell that you listened to that stuff for a period of time. So lately I haven’t been, only because I’ve been busy writing, and generally when I’m…
If you could go back in a time machine, any spots in the history of jazz that you wish you could descend into?
